title: This is not the year of agents – Andrej Karpathy
summary: Andrej Karpathy argues it is the decade, not the year, of agents, because current agents lack intelligence, multimodality, computer use and continual learning.

assertions.quote: I just think that it will take about a decade to work through all of those issues.

verdicts.note: A long-range forecast; consistent with autonomy history (self-driving) but not yet checkable.

assertions.quote: why don't you do it today? Yeah. And the reason you don't do it today is because they just don't work.

verdicts.note: Prediction tracked against 2026 reality: agents handle more scoped tasks, but end-to-end engineering (requirements, review, operations) still depends on people; METR horizons and hiring data don't support 'most or all' yet.

assertions.quote: they don't have continual learning. You can't just tell them something and they'll remember it.

verdicts.note: Model weights are fixed at deployment; persistence relies on external memory or instruction files, which only partly substitute.
